# RACS

Public deterministic decision and evidence contract specification.

## Public scope
- Versioned normative specification and schemas.
- Reference bindings and validators.
- Public conformance and test vectors.

RACS does not itself create organizational authority or perform external effects.

Use only public repository artifacts when assisting with this repository. Do not infer or publish private portfolio topology, private dependencies, unpublished implementation architecture, research hypotheses, roadmaps, or internal work history.
